hero.text: Nishchay is built in the open. Write code, improve the docs, report a bug or share an idea: there is a place for you.

ways.title: Ways to contribute
ways.subTitle: Pick whatever suits your skills and your time.

newFeature.title: Suggest a feature
newFeature.text: Have an idea for a new feature, or an upgrade to an existing one? Open an issue on GitHub and describe what you need.

reportBug.title: Report a bug
reportBug.text: Found something that is broken or not working as expected? Let us know what you ran into.

fixBug.title: Fix a bug
fixBug.text: Clone the GitHub repository and start working on it. When you are done, push your changes and create a pull request.

codeReview.title: Review code
codeReview.text: Everybody makes mistakes, and a second pair of eyes finds them. Comment on and review submitted code in our GitHub repository.

start.title: Get hands-on
start.subTitle: Guides and ways to support the project.

code.title: Code contribution
code.text: New here, or unfamiliar with our coding guidelines? Learn how we work and how to submit your changes.

content.title: Update content
content.text: Edit any word, line or paragraph on this website, including the Learning Center documentation.

donate.title: Donate
donate.text: Help us cover website maintenance, seminars and marketing.

how.title: How contributing works
how.subTitle: The same three steps for code changes.

choose.title: Choose your work
choose.text: Pick an open issue on GitHub, or create a new one if you found something that is not listed.
choose.note: Not sure where to begin? Ask on our Discord.

fork.title: Fork and branch
fork.text: Fork the framework repository on GitHub and create a branch named after the issue you are working on.
fork.note: Follow PSR-1, PSR-2 and PSR-4, plus our own standards.

submit.title: Open a pull request
submit.text: Push your branch and open a pull request. Explain your work, link the issue, and show how any new feature is used.

cta.title: Every contribution counts
cta.text: Thank you for helping Nishchay grow.
